title: lichen-node rpl_stack: no Rust test asserts survey_routing_headers rejection paths (C-only coverage)
description: Observation from the security codereview pass of the scgh fixture fix (kimi-k3 review, pass 2). RxError::InvalidSourceRoute appears only in implementation code (rpl_stack/util.rs survey_routing_headers / advance_rpl_source_route), never in a Rust assertion: the Rust suite pins only the ACCEPT path plus byte-restoration. The reject directions are pinned only on the C side (lichen/tests/rpl_srh/main.c:330-360 duplicate/multicast hops; routing_dispatch -EBADMSG cases). For P-R parity add Rust mirror tests covering the rejection matrix: grid address == unspecified/multicast/==outer-dst/==source, duplicate grid addresses, segments_left > address_count, segments_left >= hop_limit, NO_NEXT followed by bytes, more than one Routing header, non-RH3 routing type, Fragment in chain, and the sender-IID forwarding-loop check in advance (next hop == authenticated sender).
